description: The final-reply hide rule is tied to the answer marker on any successful tool result, not to emit_text specifically, while docs and comments state it as 'a successful emit_text call'; a future marker-setting tool would silently suppress the final reply.
markers.py module docstring names only the MCP-layer block builder as the marker's reader; the agent loop now also reads it via is_answer_marked to hide the final reply.
